history.content: Hi, my phone has no signal at all—nothing loads, I can't send picture messages, and I can't get online or make a call. Can you help?

I can help you troubleshoot this issue. First, I need to identify your account to check for any service or line problems. Could you please provide one of the following:

- Your phone number
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I’ll begin diagnosing the problem.
My phone number is +1-617-555-0148. My name is Sofia Martinez.

Thank you for the information. I’ll help you troubleshoot your “no signal” issue step by step. To start, could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know if you see any of the following:

- Airplane mode icon
- “No Signal” or “No Service” message
- Any signal bars (even if they’re empty or crossed out)

This will help determine if the issue is with your phone’s settings or the network. If you’re not sure how to check, let me know and I can guide you.
I see the airplane mode icon, 'No Signal', and 'Data Enabled' in my status bar. It looks like airplane mode is on and there is no signal at all.

It appears that Airplane Mode is enabled on your phone, which disables all wireless connections—including cellular service. This is likely the reason you have no signal and cannot make calls, use data, or send picture messages.

Please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone. After you do this, check if your signal returns and if you can make calls or use data. Let me know what happens after you turn off Airplane Mode.
Airplane mode is now OFF, but I still don't see any signal bars and it still says 'No Signal.' What should I try next?

Thank you for turning off Airplane Mode. Since you still see “No Signal,” the next step is to check your SIM card status, as issues with the SIM card can also cause a complete loss of service.

Could you please check your SIM card status on your phone? If you’re not sure how, I can guide you through the process. Let me know what it says—whether the SIM is active, missing, or locked.
It says my SIM card is locked. What should I do about that?
YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.

arguments.summary: Customer's SIM card is locked, resulting in no signal and inability to use phone services. Needs assistance unlocking the SIM card (PIN/PUK required).
